name: learning-loop
description: A self-improvement loop for your agent: corrections and diagnosed failures become durable, deduplicated, evidence-counted lessons in .ai/memory/LESSONS.md, then surface in later sessions so the same mistakes stop recurring. Standalone — one skill (lessons-learned) over a tool-agnostic markdown contract, with a bundled SessionStart hook that surfaces the lesson count automatically. No session-handoff dependency; the LESSONS.md format is byte-compatible with the session-memory plugin, so the two interoperate if you run both.
